## TemplateEngine.validateBlockGPaidMediaAttributes() method

Validates attributes and item constraints on `<g-paid-media>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockGPaidMediaAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

`{valid, errors}`<!-- -->; `errors` carry 1-based line numbers.

## Remarks

Checks the block-level attributes (`lang`<!-- -->, `stars`<!-- -->) via `_validateBlockAttributes`<!-- -->, then delegates structural rules (required `stars` in the 1–25000 range, 1–10 `<g-media>` items of type `photo`<!-- -->/`video` only, each with a `src`<!-- -->) to [TemplateEngine.\_validatePaidMediaItems()](./gramstax.templateengine._validatepaidmediaitems.md)<!-- -->. Returns `valid: false` with per-line errors instead of throwing, so callers can aggregate across blocks.
